status: PROPOSAL ONLY: requires Rust implementation, independent verification, and broader corpus/user calibration

metric.name: CIEDE2000
metric.color_input: opaque 8-bit sRGB converted to CIELAB with D65 reference white
metric.distance_units: Delta E 00, NOT percent RGB channel difference
metric.significant_pixel_rule: Delta E 00 > pixel_tolerance; unmatched coordinates are structural regardless of color

common.tile_grid: origins (16*i,16*j) within the canvas, i,j>=0; windows clipped at right/bottom edges
common.region_area_metric: actual unmasked significant pixel count; not bounding-box area
common.threshold_comparison: global fraction, tile fraction, tile count and region count use >=; pixel distance uses >
common.classification_rule: After comparability/mask gates and positive eligible denominator: Changed if any global, local, region, or validated height-change criterion triggers. Otherwise NoSignificantChange only within eligible coverage.
common.height_change_rule: any nonzero height delta is explicit structural review evidence after mask revalidation
common.unexpected_width_or_dpr_rule: block ordinary comparison/approval; explain profile-integrity mismatch
common.zero_eligible_rule: insufficient evidence; never NoSignificantChange, never a numeric 0 percent
common.large_mask_rule: warning only; cannot establish whole-page coverage or hide stored dimension evidence
common.rendering_environment_mismatch_rule: caution mode, not a trustworthy clean release check
common.review_decisions: unreviewed/intentional/needs-fix remain separate from metric classification
